	<ResortReportHeadline>More fun turns and Night Skiing tonight!</ResortReportHeadline>
	<ResortReport><p>Yesterday's on and off snow flurries combined with an extended run of snowmaking have definitely improved the cover across the resort.</p><p>This morning's temperatures have warmed and it's currently +0.6 which is slightly above the forecast max of 0 degrees. At 6am there's a light fog in the Village and the wind is moderate to strong out of the SW, so keep an eye on upper <a href="https://www.mthotham.com.au/mountain/conditions/lifts-terrain" rel="nofollow">lift status</a>, particularly early on.</p><p>The snowmakers were able to get a run in before the temperature spike, topping up the cover. Today might be one of those days where you'll have to feel it out. The groomers will be offering the best turns straight up. While the cover on HV has improved over recent days, it is still thin so be sure to obey all signage before moving further afield.&nbsp;</p><p>The Extreme Area remains closed due to a significant sliding hazard and please don't attempt to retrieve dropped equipment from closed areas.</p><p>In other news the Village Chair will be spinning from 7:30am for <a href="https://www.google.com/url?sa=t&amp;rct=j&amp;q=&amp;esrc=s&amp;source=web&amp;cd=&amp;ved=2ahUKEwiugv7poOyVAxX62TgGHUMQC2MQFnoECA0QAQ&amp;url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.mthotham.com.au%2Fresort%2Fthings-to-do%2Factivities%2Fwrx-first-tracks&amp;usg=AOvVaw1aau-wRs_lWOZ8GjQlCCk4&amp;opi=89978449" rel="nofollow">WRX First Tracks</a> and the Big D will be turning right through to 8pm for <a href="https://www.mthotham.com.au/resort/things-to-do/activities/night-skiing-and-snowboarding" rel="nofollow">night skiing</a>!</p><p>Rug up for the windchill and have a great day. Cheers, Burner.</p></ResortReport>
